sn22.76:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ || yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkham tad anattā || Yad anattā taṃ netaṃ mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Vedanā || pe || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam aniccaṃ || yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ netaṃ mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbam || ||
sn22.76:2.1: Evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi || saññāya pi || saṅkhāresu pi || viññāṇasmiṃ pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmim vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīnā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || Yāvatā bhikkhave sattāvāsā yāvatā bhavaggaṃ ete aggā ete seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ yad idam arahanto ti || ||
sn22.76:3.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
sn22.76:4.1: Sukhino vata arahanto || taṇhā tesaṃ na vijjati || || Asmimāno samucchinno || mohajālaṃ padālitam ||1||
sn22.76:5.1: Anejanto anuppattā || cittaṃ tesaṃ anāvilaṃ || loke anupalittā te || brahmabhūtā anāsavā ||2||
sn22.76:6.1: Pañcakkhandhe pariññāya || sattasaddhammagocarā || pasaṃsiyā sappurisā || puttā buddhassa orasā ||3||
sn22.76:7.1: Sattaratanasampannā || tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitā || Anuvicaranti mahāvīrā || pahīnabhayabheravā ||4||
sn22.76:8.1: Dasahaṅgehi sampannā || mahānāgā samāhitā || ete kho seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ || taṇhā tesaṃ na vijjati ||5||
sn22.76:9.1: Asekhañāṇam uppannaṃ || antimo yam samussayo || Yo sāro brahmacariyassa || tasmim aparapaccayā ||6||
sn22.76:10.1: Vidhāsu na vikampanti || vippamuttā punabbhavā || dantabhūmim anuppattā || te loke vijitāvino ||7||
sn22.76:11.1: Uddhaṃ tiriyaṃ apācīnaṃ || nandi tesaṃ na vijjati || nandanti te sīhanādaṃ || Buddhā loke anuttarāti ||8||
